appliesTo.$comment: Carrier acceptance. The target is CycloneDX 2.0, pinned to CycloneDX/specification 2.0-dev commit 76f185c (23 October 2026) until Ecma ratifies the release; the pinned schema is in tests/schemas/cyclonedx-2.0. 'min' is the oldest version the adapter reads: CycloneDX 1.6 and 1.7 documents are evaluated and flagged legacy, because the tools that produce CBOMs today emit 1.x. Below 'min', evaluation is refused. A derived profile may narrow this range and may not widen it.

scope.$comment: C11. Narrows the base to products as built: subject type 'product', stage 'implemented'. A supplier's migration record describes what the shipped product can do. What a deployment has enabled and negotiated is the operator's record, under the deployment profile, and the readiness gap is read by joining the two (decision 0025). Where a producer can only report an intention, the fact belongs to the capability group G1, not to a lifecycle stage. 'cryptographicPurposes' declares which purposes this profile requires in depth; every purpose in the vocabulary still owes a status under G1. See decisions 0010 and 0022.
